rungs.name: static unit-cell periodic model
rungs.note: declared impedance-surface eigenproblem, not a full-wave periodic solve

rungs.name: full transient switching
rungs.note: a modal ODE transient is executed and agrees with harmonic balance. FULL-WAVE 3D TRANSIENT FDTD IS NOT EXECUTED: it needs a dedicated CEM package and compute budget outside this repository. No result in this release depends on it.

rungs.name: coupled structural/thermal/acoustic
rungs.note: artifact magnitudes are estimated analytically in artifacts.py; a coupled multiphysics solve is future work and is required before any bench claim

rungs.name: independent cross-solver reproduction
rungs.note: two independent formulations of the annular eigenproblem agree; an independent EXTERNAL package (rung 10 in full) remains future work

outputs.rule: no result in this release rests on a NOT_EXECUTED rung

nonclaim: Computed values are simulation outputs, not measurements. This work does not demonstrate antigravity, reactionless thrust, gravity modification, free energy, or anomalous propulsion, and makes no claim about the origin or authorship of the source material.
